description: Koshi River monitoring at Chatara barrage - one of the most flood-prone rivers in Nepal. The Koshi has historically shifted course and caused massive flooding in the Terai plains.
Narayani (Gandaki) River at Narayangarh bridge. Drains the Annapurna and Manaslu massifs - high GLOF risk from glacial lake outburst floods.
Bagmati River at Chovar gorge - the sole natural outlet for the Kathmandu Valley. Flooding here directly threatens the capital.
Karnali River at Chisapani - Nepal's longest river and a major flood source for the western Terai. DHM maintains a key hydrological station here.
Melamchi River monitoring - the June 2021 flood and debris flow here destroyed the newly built Melamchi water supply tunnel intake and downstream settlements.
West Rapti River - frequent monsoon flooding affects Dang valley communities. September 2024 floods caused severe damage in this basin.
